segments.caption: A GMC Certified Service technician, Dave Campbell, stands in front of a dark blue GMC truck, speaking directly to the camera in a studio setting with a blue curtain backdrop.

A GMC Certified Service technician is shown in a professional setting, first speaking to the camera in front of a dark blue GMC Sierra pickup truck, then demonstrating a tire service procedure on a white SUV elevated in a service bay. The segment highlights official GMC vehicle maintenance and repair services.

A GMC service representative stands before a blue curtain and a dark blue GMC truck, introducing a segment on tire maintenance. The video then transitions to a split-screen comparison, visually contrasting "Good Tread" with "Bad Tread" on tires, before displaying the key recommendation: "GMC Recommends Rotating Tires Every 7,500 Miles."

This segment visually explains how to inspect tire tread depth. It begins by establishing GMC's recommendation to rotate tires every 7,500 miles, then transitions to demonstrating two methods for checking tread: using a specialized tread depth gauge and the common household trick of inserting a penny into the tread groove. The visuals compare a tire with “Good Tread” to one with “Bad Tread,” emphasizing the importance of maintaining adequate tread depth for safety.
A GMC service technician demonstrates a tire alignment procedure, using a penny to check tire wear and a specialized tool to adjust the wheel alignment on a lifted truck.

A mechanic demonstrates how to inspect and potentially replace a damaged exhaust pipe, shown by a wrench turning a bolt near the wheel well, while a presenter in a GMC-branded shirt explains the process beside a dark blue GMC Sierra pickup truck. The segment concludes with a close-up of a cracked and eroded asphalt surface, highlighting the potential road damage that can lead to exhaust system issues.

A GMC Certified Service technician speaks to the camera, with a GMC truck in the background, promoting the dealership's certified service offerings, as shown by the exterior sign and a customer interacting with a service advisor.

A GMC Certified Service technician speaks directly to the camera in a studio setting, with a dark GMC pickup truck positioned behind him. The segment concludes with the GMC logo and the website "gmccertifiedservice.com" displayed on screen, reinforcing the brand's professional service message.
